verdict.rationale: Composio's own docs and llms.txt claim 1,400+ toolkits reachable via meta-tools, sessions, MCP, and CLI, and probes confirm the docs/OpenAPI/MCP endpoint are live and functioning (though gated by auth), plus SDK packages install cleanly. One community report shows an isolated integration failure (Instagram OAuth) which doesn't contradict the breadth of the catalog itself. Missing for 10: independent third-party verification of the actual '1,400+' count beyond vendor claims.
